method.clock: Source records and scanning use TDB; recorded roots and spans use TT through the pinned ERFA geocentric TDB-minus-TT series.
method.frameCenter: ICRF physical planet center minus DE441 Sun center. The system-center trajectory selects one principal pericenter and apocenter, each matched to the nearest same-kind physical-center crossing. Uranus uses the issue-authorized DE442 barycenter embedded in URA184.
method.sampling: Evaluate the direct physical-center SPK composition every three hours, retain sign changes and exact-zero samples, bisect each bracket, and repeat at half the step to require the same crossing inventory.
method.selection: For each nominal complete orbital period, choose the daily start within 128 days of the stated preferred epoch that maximizes the smaller absolute direct-source endpoint range rate.
